text:
Nora (AE): Quick handoff: closed Equinox Labs (midmarket, EU + UK). Contract signed today. They require Private (VPC) deployment, SAML SSO, and an HSM-backed KMS. Pilot expected 300k tokens/month. Renewal in 11 months.
Diego (CS): I'll take onboarding lead. Primary contacts: mona@equinox.ai (CTO) and ben@equinox.ai (Platform). Can someone add them to a kickoff this week? :calendar:
Nora (AE): I'll intro in the invite. Legal asked for encryption attestation and data residency statement before ingesting PHI-adjacent samples.
Diego (CS): Got it. CS checklist: verify legal artifacts, collect VPC peering details, SAML metadata, and KMS thumbprint.
Omar (Solutions): I'll own the technical scoping. Need: customer VPC ASN/CIDR, KMS key id (or we can broker a temporary key), and whether they want dedicated instances or shared pool. Note: HSM-backed KMS may add ops lead time.
Rina (Support): Creating support ticket and linking to eng-runtime. Prefer to set up a dedicated internal task OQ-150 to track infra changes. Will include runbook template.
onboard-bot: Created ticket OQ-150: "Equinox private deploy - scoping" and public onboarding ticket EQ-410.
Diego (CS): Visibility table:
- CS: Diego (onboarding lead)
- AE: Nora (exec sponsor)
- Solutions/Infra: Omar (scoping & infra notes)
- Support: Rina (ticket + runbook)
Nora (AE): Renewal risk: low-to-medium. If HSM delivery slips >4 weeks we could push production beyond Q1. Flagging for prioritization.
Diego (CS): Proposed 4-week onboarding plan:
W0: kickoff, legal artifact exchange, add contacts
W1: infra scoping + SAML test in staging
W2: KMS/HSM setup + network validation
W3: private control plane cert exchange, smoke runs
W4: pilot traffic + performance verification, billing setup
Is everyone aligned?
Omar (Solutions): Aligned. I can produce infra scoping doc by Tue EOD. Risk: vendor-backed HSM provisioning may need approval from our infra team; will note rollback path to host-managed KMS for pilot. Also recommending quantized model variant for pilot to keep costs predictable.
Rina (Support): I'll attach runbook skeleton to EQ-410 and link OQ-150. Runbook excerpt:
```
Equinox private deploy smoke checklist
1) Confirm VPC peering and routes
2) Exchange SAML metadata and run assertion test for mona@equinox.ai
3) Validate KMS HSM encrypt/decrypt on sample payload
4) Run 5k token smoke at expected seq lengths, record p95 latency and GPU mem
5) Upload logs and basic cost estimate to ticket
```
Diego (CS): Meeting cadence: 30m kickoff this Thu morning CET. Nora please intro so they accept.
Nora (AE): Intro sent. Also customer requested per-environment cost breakdown (dev/staging/prod) in invoice metadata. Not urgent but good to capture as feature request.
Omar (Solutions): Will document telemetry endpoints and tagging keys to support per-env billing.
Diego (CS): Action items (owner - due):
- Nora: calendar intro + legal artifact follow-up - due in 2 business days
- Omar: infra scoping doc + model/instance recs - Tue EOD
- Rina: create EQ-410 public ticket + attach runbook - today
- Diego: kickoff invite + onboarding checklist - tomorrow
Rina (Support): EQ-410 created and linked to OQ-150. Tags: private-deploy, EU, SAML, HSM, onboarding. @Omar please add infra-change ticket IDs if needed.
Nora (AE): Customer feedback: they want visibility into token-level cost for each API route and a CSV export for finance. Potential renewal driver.
Diego (CS): Marked as product request and logged in our roadmap notes. We'll surface it post-pilot.
Omar (Solutions): Quick tech note: recommend pinning to v1-quant8 for pilot and using autoscale min=1 to keep predictable baseline. I'll include numbers in the scoping doc.
Diego (CS): Thanks team. I'll post a short summary in #customer-success after the kickoff. If HSM provisioning is delayed, we'll escalate to Nora for exec assistance and set up a cross-team bridge. :thumbsup:
